questions.def: "It" introduces a statement. "There" needs a verb of being.
questions.question: ___ is crucial to acknowledge the limitations of the study.

questions.def: "There" introduces the existence of something: a consensus.
questions.question: ___ appears to be a consensus among the researchers.

questions.def: "It seems" is the correct impersonal construction.
questions.question: ___ ___ that the hypothesis is flawed.

questions.def: "There is" introduces the existence of a doubt.
questions.question: ___ is no doubt that the results are significant.

questions.def: "It" introduces a statement about the unclear methodology.
questions.question: ___ remains unclear whether the methodology is sound.

questions.def: "It appears" is the impersonal construction.
questions.question: ___ ___ that the data supports the conclusion.

questions.def: "It" introduces a statement about considering explanations.
questions.question: ___ is important to consider alternative explanations.

questions.def: "There have been" introduces the existence of attempts.
questions.question: ___ have been several attempts to replicate the experiment.

questions.def: "It turns out" is the impersonal construction.
questions.question: ___ ___ that the initial assumption was incorrect.

questions.def: "It" introduces a statement about the theory.
questions.question: ___ is generally accepted that the theory has limitations.

questions.def: "There is" introduces the existence of a need.
questions.question: ___ is a need for further investigation into this phenomenon.

questions.def: "It has proven" is the correct impersonal construction.
questions.question: ___ ___ difficult to obtain reliable data.

questions.def: "It" introduces the suggestion about a different approach.
questions.question: ___ has been suggested that a different approach is warranted.

questions.def: "There are" introduces the existence of factors.
questions.question: ___ are several factors that could account for the discrepancy.

questions.def: "It has become" is the correct impersonal construction.
questions.question: ___ ___ increasingly clear that the model requires refinement.

questions.def: "It" introduces a statement about acknowledging contributions.
questions.question: ___ is essential to acknowledge the contributions of previous research.

questions.def: "There remains" introduces the existence of a question.
questions.question: ___ remains a question of whether the funding will be approved.

questions.def: "It would appear" is the more formal impersonal construction.
questions.question: ___ ___ that the current data does not support the hypothesis.

questions.def: "It" introduces a statement about the project's completion.
questions.question: ___ is unlikely that the project will be completed on time.

questions.def: "There are" introduces the existence of challenges.
questions.question: ___ are significant challenges associated with this new technology.

questions.def: "It is" introduces that something is considered.
questions.question: ___ ___ considered a breakthrough in the field.

questions.def: "It" introduces a statement about understanding assumptions.
questions.question: ___ is crucial to understand the underlying assumptions.

questions.def: "There appears" introduces the existence of confusion.
questions.question: ___ appears to be some confusion regarding the protocol.

questions.def: "It" is used as a dummy subject introducing a general statement.
questions.question: ___ is generally accepted that climate change poses a significant threat.

questions.def: "There" introduces the existence of something.
questions.question: ___ appears to be a misunderstanding regarding the project's objectives.

questions.def: "There seems" is the correct impersonal construction.
questions.question: ___ to have been a problem with the experimental setup.

questions.def: "It" is used with impersonal constructions expressing necessity.
questions.question: ___ is imperative that all data be carefully analyzed before publication.

questions.def: "It" is used to introduce a suggested idea or proposal.
questions.question: ___ has been suggested that further research is warranted.

questions.def: "There appear" is correct because "discrepancies" is plural.
questions.question: ___ to be some discrepancies in the financial reports.

questions.def: "It" introduces a clause expressing uncertainty.
questions.question: ___ remains unclear whether the proposed changes will be effective.
